comment: Spec §13 with the D-022 names, made ASSERTION-AWARE by D-029/D-032 (G0-B.1): a relation is the proposition (kind, source, target); each source occurrence is an assertion carrying the occurrence's attributes (role, outcome, executed, …), so rules that read an occurrence attribute join asrt/aattr instead of rattr. Facts are projected from records by lib/facts.mjs: node(L,K); attr(L,N,V); rel(R,K,S,T); rattr(R,N,V) for the proposition-level relation attrs; asrt(A,Subject,Loc) for every assertion record; aattr(A,N,V) for its attrs. Variables are an initial capital followed by lowercase letters, digits or underscores (C, W, Subject, Var1); any other string is a constant (WITNESSES, RECEIPT, executed). D-037: transition → claim is STATE_TRANSITION_OF, and SUPERSEDES holds only between comparable kinds, so `superseded`/`current` (unchanged here) read a real replacement. Strata: 0 positive, 1 one negation each over stratum 0 and facts. Every derived fact records its rule id and premises; nothing here is a TRVM derivation (D-007, D-019).

attr.doc: attr(lid, name, value) — one fact per attrs field of a node

rattr.doc: rattr(relation_lid, name, value) — one fact per proposition-level attrs field of a relation

asrt.doc: asrt(assertion_lid, subject_lid, location_lid) — one fact per assertion record (a node's or a relation's)

aattr.doc: aattr(assertion_lid, name, value) — one fact per attrs field of an assertion: the occurrence's role, outcome, executed, what, part, …

rules.name: has_exec_receipt
rules.doc: D-032 (the G0 admissibility rule), GENERIC over any subject (D-037): a RECEIPT node whose recorded sha256 verifies at the pin WITNESSES the subject — a CLAIM or an EVIDENCE_STATE_TRANSITION or anything else a receipt witnesses — and the citing assertion says the promotion it belongs to was executed. Two citations of one receipt are two derivations of one fact. The A6 rules restrict the subject to tested claims by joining tested_claim; this rule does not.

rules.name: supports
rules.doc: outcome is an occurrence attribute (D-029): a WITNESSES statement plus an assertion carrying outcome pass

rules.name: tested_claim
rules.doc: token_family is an adapter attribute from a frozen grammar: the token starts with TESTED

rules.name: no_exec_receipt_observed
rules.doc: absence is decidable only where the source types its receipts (receipts_typed = true); the D-022 vocabulary, never the withdrawn word
